summary: Feature 26 'Job Search' (replacement of Jobs Portal) end-to-end verification — Backend (12 API tests) and Frontend (React Native Web / Expo Router). BACKEND: 11 passed + 1 skipped (fresh-user 400 skipped because free-tier register→ /api/job-search/* is blocked by subscription gate — flagged below; the 400 'Complete your career profile first' case itself is code-correct and covered by /_require_profile). All core endpoints work: PUT+GET /api/job-search/profile persists (headline+summary+skills+experience_years+remote), GET /jobs?q=engineer returns 32+ jobs with all required fields, unauth = 401, POST /match returns AI 5-dim fit score (overall_score, recommendation, dimensions, strengths, gaps), POST /documents/generate returns cv_markdown (~1400+ chars) + cover_letter_markdown + reviewer_notes, POST /ats-check returns ats_score + covered/missing keywords + parseability + recommendations, ats-check without generated docs = 400, tracker CRUD works (create 200, duplicate 409, patch to interview 200 with history growth, invalid status 400, delete 200, GET list), summary returns all 7 counts, /api/features/registry entry feature_id=jobs-portal now has title='Job Search', route='/job-search', icon='search', enabled=true. FRONTEND (admin@realaicoach.app): /job-search loads with all testids (job-search-page, job-search-hero, job-search-step-bar, 4 step buttons, 4 summary metric cards). Sidenav rename verified ('Job Search' string present in sidenav). /job-platform redirects to /job-search. Profile Save: filled headline/summary/skills, clicked job-search-profile-save, job-search-profile-status shows 'Profile saved. AI matching will now use your latest details.' Find Jobs: job-search-query-input='engineer' + job-search-search-btn returns job-search-job-card-0 (Careers Operations Analyst / SEO Manager). Documents Tab: job-search-generate-docs-btn, job-search-doc-content (CV markdown rendered), job-search-doc-view-cv, job-search-doc-view-cover, job-search-doc-copy-btn, job-search-ats-btn all present. Tracker Tab: job-search-tracker-row-0 renders. Command palette (Ctrl+K) shows 'Job Search'. Dark-mode toggle switches bg to rgb(5,10,24). Mobile 390px: hero, workspace, 4 metric cards, step buttons render responsively.

minor.issue: Free-tier authenticated users receive 403 'This feature requires a Basic plan or higher' on ALL /api/job-search/* endpoints (profile, jobs, summary, match). Legacy /api/jobs/* was free-auth accessible (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md line 183-188, iteration_183). If the intent is to gate Job Search behind Basic+, that's a business decision; otherwise this is a regression from legacy Jobs Portal. Recommend confirming intent and either (a) adding /api/job-search/ to FREE_PATTERNS in access_control_engine.py or (b) documenting the plan requirement in the spec + surfacing an upgrade CTA on the frontend for free users.

ui_bugs.issue: Residual error banner 'Could not load open jobs right now.' remains visible after a subsequent successful search (state errorMsg is set on failure but not cleared when the follow-up loadJobs succeeds and jobs render). Reproduce: trigger a first-load failure (e.g., 429/network hiccup), then click Search — cards render below but the red error message persists. Fix: setErrorMsg('') on successful load in loadJobs (already done at start of loadJobs; but if the request throws then a retry that succeeds should also explicitly clear). Actually the current code sets '' at start of loadJobs before try, so this should work — verify state race: the search error may be a different message coming from useEffect initial mount that failed. Suggest also clearing errorMsg in a finally-success branch and on searchBtn click.

action_items: CONFIRM INTENT (or fix regression): decide whether free-tier authenticated users should be able to use /api/job-search/* (legacy Jobs Portal was free). Currently 403 blocks free users at profile/jobs/summary/match. If intended, ensure the Job Search page renders an upgrade CTA / paywall UI for free users instead of a blank surface on 403.

MINOR UX: clear the 'Could not load open jobs right now.' error banner in FindJobsTab whenever a subsequent successful search loads jobs (or on Search button press). Currently the banner can linger after a transient 429.

OPTIONAL: for the fresh-user 400 'Complete your career profile first' path, the code correctness is confirmed by inspection of _require_profile in /app/backend/routes/job_search.py, but the automated test was skipped due to the free-tier 403 gate — once free access is decided, re-enable the test.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/job_search.py is well-structured (462 lines, single responsibility, uses cookie-auth via require_auth, excludes _id in all reads, has proper 400/401/404/409 codes, non-blocking email failure). No changes recommended.

Frontend /app/frontend/app/job-search.tsx (168 lines) + 5 tab components under /app/frontend/src/components/jobSearch/ — clean separation of concerns. All interactive elements carry both data-testid AND testID (react-native-web + native compat). No file >280 lines. LGTM.
Feature registry entry updated correctly (title=Job Search, route=/job-search, icon=search, enabled=true). Sidenav in AppShell shows the renamed label. Command palette registered.

Potential inconsistency: legacy Jobs Portal (feature_id=jobs-portal) was free-tier accessible; new Job Search under the same feature_id is basic-tier gated by subscription_enforcement middleware. This may be intentional (candidate-only paid product) or an oversight. Worth an explicit call-out in the PRD.
